_comment: AS 3600:2018 Table 3.1.2 -- properties of standard-strength concrete.
This file is REFERENCE DATA (ASET component 1). It is deliberately held as
a data file rather than in Python so that it can be checked, corrected and
signed off by an engineer who does not read code.
VERIFICATION: set status to VERIFIED and fill in checked_by/checked_on only
after every row has been confirmed against the printed standard. Until then
every number below is UNVERIFIED and must not be relied on for issue.
Ec here is the TABULATED value, which assumes a density of 2400 kg/m^3.
For any other density the Cl 3.1.2 expression is used instead.
